text: M100 Cuisses are heavy legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. A slotted version can be dropped by the Protective Torquidon.

M100 Greaves are heavy feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They use the latest materials from Mechonis. A slotted version can be bought from a Nopon Merchant just north of the Hope Farm in Colony 6 after the events of the Mechonis Core. They can also be dropped by the Firework Geldesia, and be obtained as a quest reward after completing Best Boots. It is part of the M100 set of armour along with with the M100 Helm, M100 Plate, M100 Arms and M100 Cuisses.

Lurgy (Japanese: , Dokudoku damo) is one of Riki's Ether arts in . When hit, enemies will be afflicted with Poison for thirty seconds, doing additional damage equal to the attack's initial damage every 2 seconds.
Loki Drones are Mechonis Drones in . They can be obtained from various high-level enemies or from a shop in Colony 6.
The Lion Cutlass (Japanese: , Shishitō) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a sword wielded by Dunban.

Longevity Biters (Japanese: , Kurisurokku, Chris Rock) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are biters wielded by Riki. They can be acquired by purchasing them at Colony 6 Shop 6 for 24,600 G or by trading with Don Argentis who can be found in Alcamoth.

Love Biters (Japanese: , Ai no Kamukamu) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are biters wielded by Riki. They can be aquired by purchasing them at the Syrath Lighthouse Shop in Eryth Sea for 15,300 G or by trading with Ma'crish who can be found in Colony 6.

Lubricant Oil is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is obtained from Lupa after completing Mystery of Makna Ruins 3. This item allows the party to move the coffin in King Agni's Tomb in Makna Forest (as asked to in Mystery of Makna Ruins 4).

This quest will expire after the events at the Mechonis Core. Looking for Gold Bugs (Japanese: , Kin'iro no Mushi wo Motomete) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Teelan in Alcamoth. If Shulk is the active party, he will comment.

Lucky Fangs are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Feris in Satorl Marsh, and cannot be traded for. According to their description, they are fangs used in necklaces and even possessing one brings good luck. One is needed for Replica Monado 1.

The Lurker Brog (Japanese: , Yamikakure Guroggu) is a one-of-a-kind quest exclusive enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is not a Unique Monster. It is a member of the Brog family, and can be found at level 11 on the ground floor of the Spring of Grief in Tephra Cave. It drops the Brog Smelling Salts needed for Material Quest 2. The Lurker Brog only appears during the quest A Young Captain's Rise. Completing the quest requires defeating either the Lurker Brog or the Lurker Krabble. Once one of them is defeated, the other is no longer available to fight.

This quest will expire after the events at the Mechonis Core. Losing the Taste for Alcohol (Japanese: , Osake ni Tsuyokunaritai) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Nelo by the Fountain of Hope in Alcamoth. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.

The Lurker Krabble (Japanese: , Yamikakure Kuraibu) is a quest exclusive enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is not a Unique Monster. It is a member of the Krabble family, and can be found at level 10 near Vilia Lake in Tephra Cave. The Lurker Krabble only appears during the quest A Young Captain's Rise. Completing the quest requires defeating either the Lurker Krabble or the Lurker Brog. Once one of them is defeated, the other is no longer available to fight.
Lizards (Japanese: , Rizado) are a family of small reptilian creatures in the , similar to Upas. All lizards are identical, and brown with red spots.

Looking for Freedom (Japanese: , Jiyū wo Motomete) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Nopo'rikh in Reconstruction HQ in Colony 6. If Melia is in the active party, she will comment.
M32 Scout Units (Japanese: , Sanjūnishiki: Teisatsugata) are Mechon enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found at level 15 near Raguel Bridge - South and Maguel Road on Bionis' Leg.
Lubum Antols (Japanese: , Rubūmu Antoru) are enemies in . They are members of the Antol family, and can be found at level 24 near the Pod Depot outside Colony 6 before the events at Mechonis Core.

M32 Transport Units (Japanese: , Sanjūnishiki: Unpangata) are Mechon enemies in . They can be found at level 19 – 21 in the Ether Mine, specifically by the Regulation Piston, the north bridge, and the southernmost ether deposit of Central Pit - Level 2; and over the west bridge of Central Pit - Level 3. These areas all become inaccessible after using the Freight Elevator to exit the mine.

Lupus Feris (Japanese: , Rupusu Ferisu) are enemies in . They are members of the Feris family, and can be found at level 34 north of the Village Entrance in Makna Forest. They are usually in a unit with two Makna Feris. They can drop Feris Blood, which is needed for Losing the Taste for Alcohol.

M34 Honey Bee Units (Japanese: , Sanjūyonshiki Mitsubachi-gata) are Mechon enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found at level 46 in Sword Valley between the 4th Gate and 5th Gate and at the 6th Gate.

M35 Woodpecker Units (Japanese: , Sanjūgoshiki Kitsutsuki-gata) are Mechon enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found at level 48 in Sword Valley at the Port Access Pathway and the Port Maintenance Bay.

M104 Fortress Units (Japanese: , Hyakuyonshiki Yōsai-gata) are Mechon enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found patrolling various locations in Sword Valley - the 6th Gate, 4th Gate, Control Tower and Radio Tower. It is wise to equip some Anti-Mechon Weapons before fighting it.

M35 Wasp Units (Japanese: , Sanjūgoshiki Ashinagabachi-gata) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are Mechon, and can be found in the Main Maintenance Bay and the Ether Input Stream in Galahad Fortress.
M34 Hornet Units (Japanese: , Sanjūyonshiki Yadorigibachi-gata) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are Mechon, and can be found at the Ether Input Stream in Galahad Fortress.

M37 Worker Bee Units (Japanese: , Sanjūnanashiki Kumabachi-gata) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are Mechon, and can be found at level 55 on the Fallen Arm on Digit 5 Beach and on the plain between the Connecting Bridge and the Black Wreckage.

Lucky Skeeter Wings are rare materials in . They can be dropped by Chordy Skeeters in Colony 9 or traded for with Narine and Nic before he moves to Colony 6. According to their description, they are wings that bring good luck and people are thrilled to get them as gifts. Two are needed for Betty's Gift.
The Lost Pendant is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is the object of The Lost Pendant. It can be found near the northwest corner of Vilia Lake in Tephra Cave.

Luxury Hode Wood are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is dropped by various Hodes in Eryth Sea and can be traded for in Alcamoth and Eryth Sea. According to their description, they are high quality pieces of lumber that could make a house of superior sturdiness. Three pieces of it are needed for Mend the Plant.

The M100 Set is a Heavy Armour armour set in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is Mechon styled armour which resembles the Empress Set and the Eclipse Set. The set can contain up to one empty slot, and can be worn by all characters except Fiora.
The Lower Bulkhead Bridge (Japanese: , Kishin Daikakuheki Kabu Renrakubashi) is a landmark in . It is located on the third floor of Mechonis Field.

Lucky Arachno Boxes are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by high-level Pods on Bionis' Leg and in Tephra Cave, and is not available for trade. According to their description, they are boxes that bring one piece of good luck and it is said that some people have found ten Gold.

Living Antol Eyes are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various Antols on the Bionis' Leg, and can also be traded for with Olga before either The Road Home or To Colony 6! is completed and the refugees move back to Colony 6. According to their description, they are eyes that live without a body and leaving them be will cause them to sprout legs.

Lin Lee Koo (Japanese: , Rinrī Kū, Lynlee Ku; English dub: ), better known by her nickname Lin, is one of the eight main playable characters of . She is the narrator of the main story's prologue and epilogue. She is called Linly (English dub: ) by Tatsu. Lin is the second scripted party member to be revealed after Elma. She is described as a genius and is an expert engineer at BLADE. She is a member of the Outfitters Division, involved in the development of the Skells. Lin joins the party after she is met during Chapter 1.

Longswords are melee weapons in . They are the melee weapon for Strikers, and can be further mastered through the Samurai Gunner and Duelist Classes. Longswords are also the melee weapons used by Gwin, Frye, Nagi, and Al. Certain Tyrants can drop uniquely-named longswords.

This page lists locations where Ether Crystals can be mined in . For locations on Bionis, these are ether crystal deposits. For locations on Mechonis, these are ether gears. The numbers in each area correspond with the numbers on the area maps on the [http://translate.google.com/translate?hl=en&sl=ja&tl=en&u=http%3A%2F%2Fxenobladedata.web.fc2.com%2F&sandbox=1 JCE].

The Live Recording is an official live performance of five songs from to celebrate the release of . On 28 March 2015, a Nintendo event was broadcasted for the upcoming release of . The live stream dealt with the presentation of the game by Tetsuya Takahashi and Genki Yokota, followed by a live recording of five tracks from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. These songs were performed and orchestrated by ACE+ band accompanied by a string quartet. This Live Recording performance was then diffused by NicoNico on their YouTube channel. # Main Theme # Gaur Plain # Mechanical Rhythm # Engage the Enemy # You Will Know Our Names

Little Femina Suids (Japanese: , Ritoru Femina Zūsu) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Suid family, and resemble smaller Brass Suids and Brass Femina Suids. They can be found at level 1-50 in Primordia, at Arendt Bridge, West Gate Plain, and Talon Rock Third Terrane.

Luciel, the Eternal (Japanese: , Yūkyū no Rusheru) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Millesaur family. It can be found at level 92 at Janpath Lake or West Janpath Plain in Primordia. It walks to the southwest shore of Janpath Lake and drinks for a while before walking to the southeast side of the lake and drinking for a while before repeating the process. All of Luciel's arts inflict Topple.
Lurker Suids (Japanese: , Anbusshu Zūsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Suid family, and can be found at level 31-37 northeast of FN Site 202 in Noctilum.

Ludvik, the Picky Eater (Japanese: , Henshoku no Rudovīku) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an Evello and can be found at level 29 on Keegan Ridge in Oblivia during the day. Defeating it is required for the eponymous Basic Mission Ludvik, the Picky Eater.

The Lotus Keep Building Site (Japanese: , Hasumi Yōsai Kensetsuchi) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, east of the Upper Hushflood and directly north of FN Site 208. It is a Ganglion base, though not a large one. A pond of poisonous water can be found north of the site.

Lost Caro (Japanese: , Rosuto Nokkusu) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caro family and can be found at level 51-70 in Cauldros. They can be found at level 51 in the Old Ceremonial Hollow, where they accompany the Marnuck that patrol the area, level 62-66 in the Bestial Utopia, and a single level 63 one can be found deep in the Ganglion Antropolis.

Lophids (Japanese: , Rofiru; English dub: ) are Piscinoid enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They look like armored, eyeless anglerfishes of the Lophiidae (Goosefish) family. They can be found in Primordia and Cauldros.
Lively Tersquals (Japanese: , Rivu Rakenma) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Tersqual family. They can be found at level 51-55 in Lake Ciel in Sylvalum.
Lucy is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found in the Central Industrial District of New Los Angeles during the day.

Logi Scirpos (Japanese: , Rogi Shirunea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scirpo family, and can be found at level 12-19 under the arch near Broken Hill BC and under Big Arch in Oblivia.
Lularita (English dub: ) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Nopon and can be found at the Drongo Caravan in Cauldros.

|-|Primordia= |-|Oblivia= |-|Cauldros= Lineage (Japanese: , Rain Eiji) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Human-Made Skell with an Urban frame, and is piloted by Alex. Lineage is fought as a normal mission exclusive enemy at level 33 at Headwater Summit in Primordia during the normal mission Alien Nation, if the player does not side with Alex. It is fought as a normal mission exclusive enemy at level 30 during Shotgun Diplomacy near Balance Rock in Oblivia. Lineage is fought as a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss at level 43 during the mission Alex's Last Stand in Cauldros. Its arts include Homing Arrow (beam), Shotgun (physical), Negative Pulse (beam), Gravity Sh
Liviana is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at North Founders Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.
Lulladu is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Central Industrial District in New Los Angeles.
Liza (Japanese: , Raiza) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Integrated Production Plant in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.
Lucia is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at Ishmael Hills in the Residential District of New Los Angeles during the night.

Lockhart, the Killer of Hope (Japanese: , Zetsubō no Rokkuhāto) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Vivohast family. It can be found at level 52 near Lake Ciel in Sylvalum. It is located in the map segment between FN Site 411 and FN Site 414. Its appearance is rare. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Lockhart, the Killer of Hope and will complete the segment recon for its map hex.
Lionhearted (Japanese: , Shishifunjin) is an Affinity Mission in . It can be accepted near O'rrh Sim Castle Ruins in Cauldros. It is the only Affinity Mission that is not found in New Los Angeles.
M'gando Gorge BC (Japanese: , Mi-Gando Keikoku BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a BLADE basecamp located in the M'gando Gorge in Cauldros, run by the Pathfinders.

M'gando Gorge (Japanese: , Mi-Gando Keikoku) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros, to the east of Mount M'gando and adjacent to the Boxtrap Checkpoint. The M'gando Gorge BC is located here.

Loathsome Blobs (Japanese: , Kiraware-dama) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum, in particular southwest of FN Site 209 in Noctilum Waters. Seven of them are needed for Must-Have Blobs.

The M'gando Volcanic Crater (Japanese: , Mi-Gando-san Higuchi) is a Scenic Viewpoint in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the hollow of the Mount M'gando volcano in Cauldros. The FN Site 513 is here, and there are no enemies within the crater itself—although there are several on its edge. The crater is a bottomless chasm like the Yawning Giant. As with all Scenic Viewpoints, its discovery yields an achievement ("At the M'gando Volcanic Crater").

The M'gando Mineral Spring (Japanese: , Mi-Gando Kōsen) is an Unexplored Territory in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a cave located in Cauldros, near the peak of Mount M'gando. It contains a Treasure Box and a single Sacrifole Tyrant, disguised amongst innocuous flowers. As with all Unexplored Territories, its discovery yields an achievement ("The Waters of M'gando Mineral Spring").

Logunie's Driftwoods (Japanese: , Rogunie no Ryūboku) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, north of Arendt Bridge, close to Castaway Cavern, primarily during the day. Three pieces of Logunie's Driftwood are required for the Normal Mission The Journey Begins.

Logunie's Driftwood Boats (Japanese: , Rogunie no Kibune) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum, in particular around FN Site 205. Seven are needed for the Basic Mission In Search of New Horizons.
Lost Memory Synthesizers (Japanese: , Rosutomemorī Gōseiki) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia, in particular near FN Site 320.
Lionbone Borts are rare Precious Resources in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are a component of many Rank V augments.
Loma is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Nopon Bazaar in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles at daytime.

The Link Satellis (Japanese: , Rinku Sateresu) is a Main Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is fought at level 46 at Lifehold Core's Interior during Chapter 12. It assists the Vita during the second round. When an ally is toppled, it launches a laser causing an amount of damage. This boss and the other Satellises are not registered in the Enemy Index, only the Vita and the Sentinel Satellis will be registered.
Lomoth, the Beast-Eater (Japanese: , Shokujūka Rōmosu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Germivore family. It can be found hidden at level 28 at Primeval Meadow in Oblivia.

Lyla, the Lustrous (Japanese: , Shunkō no Raira) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Milsaadi Ganglion member. She can be found at level 44 inside the Den of the Dead in Sylvalum. Lyla appears when approaching the alien treasure chest in the southeast corner of the den's largest room.

Lyla's Galdr (Japanese: , Raira Sen'yō Garudora) is a Tyrant in . It is a Galdr machine. It can be found at level 55 southwest of Hardheart Canyon in Sylvalum at early morning. It is the Galdr of Lyla, the Lustrous. Defeating it is required to complete Off the Record (mechanical) in the original version.
The Logistical Support Quo (Japanese: , Kōhō Shien-gata Kuō) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Quo machine. It can be found at level 46 at Bedrock Hold in Primordia.
Logi Blattas (Japanese: , Rogi Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 41-50 at the Vitriol Cesspool in Noctilum.

Lunar Cetos (Japanese: , Runa Burikio) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Ceto family, and can be found at level 41-45 at Garden Spring and at level 46-50 at Dead Man's Ingress, near FN Site 221, in Noctilum during the night.
Loda Gorida (Japanese: , Roda Gorido) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles during the night.
Long Shot is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Astral Crusader at rank 2. Cross and Lao can use this skill.
Long Topple is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Shield Trooper at rank 6. Cross, Lin, L, and H.B. can use this skill.

Luminous Puges (Japanese: , Ruminasu Berude) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Puge machines, Ganglion's human size robots, and can be found at level 51 on the rock structure southwest of FN Site 415 and at level 59 at Cavernous Abyss in Sylvalum.
The Lumenoa Leaf is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It must be collected on the Far Isle of Tzu'o in Cauldros during House Call.
Lucky Rainbow Whiskers are unique materials in . They can be obtained from Balaenas. One is needed for Mia Grows Up.

The Lowly Terebra (Japanese: , Rōrī Rutoru) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Terebra family, and can be found at level 32 at Primordia's Biahno Lake. Defeating it is required for one route of the Normal Mission Setting Forth. It drops the Smelly Legen-dar.

Lonlon is a Nopon in . He can be found at the Integrated Production Plant (X: -8.75; Y: 3.65) in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles exclusively during Trade Agreement. He is the owner of a Silver Evello Card which can be traded for. He can only be registered on the Affinity Chart by talking to him during this mission, even if he is not chosen for trading.

Lone Survivors (Japanese: , Sabaibāzu) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from Robert in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles. Yin'tonam gives the Summoning Goggles at the beginning of the mission to help finding Kan'tonam.
Lophid Jaw Meats are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Lophids.

Lyvia (Japanese: , Rivia) is an NPC in . Lyvia is the Human appearance of LV757: Lyvia, and has a separate entry in the Affinity Chart. They can be found by the round garden southeast of the Residential District's Cathedral. Lyvia's appearance and gender are determined when they first appear in New Los Angeles, being female if Cross is male, and male if Cross is female.
Longevity Boughs are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Cervuses in Sylvalum. One is needed for Herbivores, Unite!.
Lilting Lilies is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a male BLADE and the primary destination is Noctilum.
Lost Memento is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request to find a locket out in Oblivia.

The Linker Scirpo (Japanese: , Rinkā Shirunea) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a level 40 member of the Scirpo family, and is fought at FN Site 217 in Noctilum during The Ultimate Price.

Love and Loss is Doug's fifth Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is available after Chapter 12 if Doug's affinity is at 5♥ and Doug's previous Heart-to-Hearts have already been visited, and occurs in the Administrative District, west of Division Drive and north of Armory Alley. Upon completing this Heart-to-Heart, all gear that was equipped on Lao prior to starting Chapter 9 is returned to inventory.

Lone Purple Ictus Stingers are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from green and black Ictuses, or for 114 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Melee Attack Boost and Boost.M-ATK augments.

Lone Red Ictus Stingers are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from purple Ictuses, or for 114 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Critical Chance Up and CriticalUp augments.

Lone White Ictus Stingers are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from peach-colored Ictuses, or for 114 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Ranged Attack Boost and Boost.R-ATK augments.
Luminescent Antennae are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Tectinsulas and Arenatects.
Luminescent Tails are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Cantors.

Lucky Cervus Saplings are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Cervuses. One is required for From Idea to Inventory. They are components in all AppendLost.GP augments.
Lophid A is a Holofigure in . It depicts a black lophid variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Izgnanie, the Smoldering in Cauldros.
Lophid B is a Holofigure in . It depicts a green lophid variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Ridill, the Arrogant in Primordia.

Littlepon is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a female Nopon throwing a Nopon doll in the air. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission My Angel, My Lana.
Luxaar's Ship is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts the ship used by Luxaar. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Prospective Partners.

Love in the Orchard is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.16, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of collecting six Fruits. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Limited Tank Tops are casual torso armors made by Sakuraba Industries in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are available through several missions. All colors in this set have the same stats.

M-Snipers are shoulder weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Ciniculas or Xe-doms. Intergalactic-quality M-Snipers have the weapon name M-XXSniper, but are otherwise the same type of weapon.
This is a list of pre-release and unused content for the game .

Limited Trekware are Casual Wear upper-body armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.

Lin's Armwear L is Light Wear left arm armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Lin's initial gear when she joins the team, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Lin's Legwear is Light Wear leg armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Lin's initial gear when she joins the team, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Lovestruck Hibiscuses are Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are exclusively obtained from Telethia Plume.

M-Auto.BLACKOUT is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a chance of inflicting the Blackout Debuff with a melee auto-attack. It is the Skell equivalent of Melee: Blackout.
M-Auto.FATIGUE is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a chance of inflicting the Fatigue Debuff with a melee auto-attacks. It is the Skell equivalent of Melee: Fatigue.

M-Auto.PHYS-DOWN is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a chance of inflicting the Physical Res Down Debuff with a melee auto-attack. It is the Skell equivalent of Melee: Physical Res Down.

M-Auto.BEAM-DOWN is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a chance of inflicting the Beam Res Down Debuff with a melee auto-attack. It is the Skell equivalent of Melee: Beam Res Down.

M-Auto.ETHER-DOWN is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a chance of inflicting the Ether Res Down Debuff with a melee auto-attack. It is the Skell equivalent of Melee: Ether Res Down.

M-Auto.THERM-DOWN is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a chance of inflicting the Thermal Res Down Debuff with a melee auto-attack. It is the Skell equivalent of Melee: Thermal Res Down.

M-Auto.ELEC-DOWN is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a chance of inflicting the Electric Res Down Debuff with a melee auto-attack. It is the Skell equivalent of Melee: Electric Res Down.

M-Auto.GRAV-DOWN is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a chance of inflicting the Gravity Res Down Debuff with a melee auto-attack. It is the Skell equivalent of Melee: Gravity Res Down.
M-Auto.BLAZE is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a chance of inflicting the Blaze Debuff with a melee auto-attack. It is the Skell equivalent of Melee: Blaze.
M-Auto.Shock is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a chance of inflicting the Shock Debuff with a melee auto-attack. It is the Skell equivalent of Melee: Shock.
M-Auto.HP-RECOVERY is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a chance of recovering HP when using a melee auto-attack. It is the Skell equivalent of Melee: Recover HP.
Limited Scouters are Casual Wear Head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.
M-MODY-DEF2 is a Skell Wear torso armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
M-LARM-MEL2 is a Skell Wear arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X.

List of Craftable Weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. These weapons can be crafted at the AM Terminal in Armory Alley by selecting Develop New Gear then Weapons. Many of them require that Schematics be acquired before they can be crafted. This list is in the same order as in the game's menu. Items marked "N/A" do not need to be unlocked.
Lovestruck Kitty Ears are casual head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
This is a list of pre-release and unused content for the game and .

The Loading Bay (Japanese: , Kamotsu Hannyūguchi) is a location in . It is located in the Ancient Ship, beyond Hold #2 and above Fuel Tank #2 and the System Control Room. There are several Treasure Troves here.
Limuli (Japanese: , Rimurimu) is an NPC in . Limuli is a Nopon who can be found on the Salvage Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Lysaats (Japanese: , Shīsu) are a family of enemies in . They are aquatic insectoids similar to isopods, and often appear after Salvaging. They come in gray and black varieties.

Lyta Oasis (Japanese: , Rita no Oashisu) is a landmark in . It is located on the right side of the upper level of Gormott Province, under the massive tree that comprises Twin Trunks Hill. There is a Treasure Trove here. This area was previously known as Serene Springside, but was renamed by the Blade Kaeda after her Driver, Lyta.

The Living Quarters (Japanese: , Kyojūku) are a location in . They are a room within the Titan Battleship, which is moored in the Gormott Province, between the Mid-ship Walkway Door and Olno's Mess Hall. There is a Treasure Trove here.
The Little Banerro Ruins (Japanese: , Banero Koiseki) are a landmark in . They are located on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, between Litharia Snowfield and Fable Rock.

Litharia Snowfield (Japanese: , Rizarea Hiroba) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, beyond Genbu Port and before Fable Rock. The Salvager's Diary and a Beta Scope can be found inside a Treasure Trove buried in this location, during the quest Glory from the Past. The Field Skills Earth Mastery Lv.4 and Keen Eye Lv.4 are required to unearth it.

Lumos Pillar (Japanese: , Ruminaria Shichū) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, between the Sekis Pillar and the Gates of Ulcaria. The pillar can be traveled down to reach Lumos Pedestal on the Lower Level of Tantal.

Lumos Pedestal (Japanese: , Ruminaria no Daiza) is a Landmark in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, directly below the Lumos Pillar, which can be climbed up to. It lies to the east of Genbu Drifts, with the Argan Iceblooms close-by to the north-east.

Lud Cloudway: Rigitte (Japanese: , Rudo Unkaidō - Rijite-guchi) is a landmark in . It is located in the Cloudway of the Leftherian Archipelago, between the Isle of Sleeping Remains and Godsford Isle. It leads directly to Lud Cloudway: Fonsett.

Lud Cloudway: Fonsett (Japanese: , Rudo Unkaidō - Iyasaki-guchi) is a landmark in . It is located in the Cloudway of the Leftherian Archipelago, between Godsford Isle and the Isle of Sleeping Remains. It connects directly to Lud Cloudway: Rigitte.

The Lost Capital Judicium (Japanese: , Kodai Toshi Yūdikiumu) is a Secret Area in . It is located in the innermost area of the Ruins of Judicium in Temperantia, beyond the Titan Weapon Dig Site. The Nopon Nonono can be found in this place. It must be visited to unlock Perceval's level 3 "Assassination" Field Skill. There are no enemies here except during Blade-Sharp Memory.

The Lower Level (Japanese: , Kasō) of the Gormott Province is a level in . The entire area is affected by the Cloud Sea and is only accessible during low tide. It is always shrouded in fog from the Cloud Sea, and leads up to the Upper Level - Right. When the Cloud Sea tide is high, this level is inaccessible.

Lv. 2, Mizar: Lower Deck (Japanese: , Dainisō Rakia: Kasō Dekki) is a landmark in . It is located on the Lower Level of the World Tree, between Lv. 2, Mizar: Mid Floor and Mizar, Elevator #8. There is one Collection Point here.

Lv. 2, Mizar: Central Deck (Japanese: , Dainisō Rakia: Chūō Dekki) is a landmark in . It is located on the Lower Level of the World Tree, between Mizar, Elevator #8 and the Nuclear Dump Facility. There are two Treasure Troves here.
Lv. 2, Mizar: Mid Floor (Japanese: , Dainisō Rakia: Chūō Furoa) is a location in . It is located on the Lower Level of the World Tree, between Benetnash, Elevator #6 and Lv. 2, Mizar: Lower Deck.

Lv. 3, Alioth (Japanese: , Daisansō Shehakimu) is a landmark in . It is an open room located on the Mid Level of the World Tree beyond the Skywalk, and leads to Alioth, Elevator #3. The Nameless Sentinel is found here during Mystery Launch Codes, and no other enemies will spawn here until its defeat.

Lv. 4, Megrez (Japanese: , Daiyonsō Zeburu) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the World Tree. This level is beyond the Megrez Gateway houses Megrez, Elevator #1 that serves as the connection between the World Tree and the First Low Orbit Station. This is where Jin is fought for the last time, and where Amalthus is defeated. After entering the First Low Orbit Station, the Superboss Mk. VII Arek spawns here.
The Llysiau Deeds are Store Deeds in . They can be purchased from Llysiau Greens in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Lunana Smoothies are Drink Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Café Savvy run by Adwen in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Herald.
Love Beyond the Clouds are Literature Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Haskefell Books in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Llysiau Greens is a shop in . It is run by Tenne and can be found in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. It is specialized in Veggies.
Lucisthenes is an NPC in . Lucisthenes is a Tantalese who can be found in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. Lucisthenes runs a shop called Lectica Vegetables specialized in Veggies.
Linnaea is an NPC in . Linnaea is a Tantalese who can be found in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. Linnaea runs a shop called Boldarde Textiles specialized in Textiles.
* Little Bunnit (XC1) * Little Bunnit (XC2) * Little Bunnit (XC3)

Limdo Flamiis (Japanese: , Rimudo Furamī) are enemies in . They are members of the Flamii family and can be found at level 17-22 in the Kingdom of Uraya, particularly at the Cleansing Spring, Lake Varna, Eight-Rock Skip and Fonsa Myma Waters.

Loska's Gap (Japanese: , Rosuka no Ōana) is a location in . It is located in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya, on a path downhill north-west from the Stone Gate Ruins. There are two Treasure Troves here, and an underground spring that can be activated with level 2 Water Mastery and level 2 Fortitude field skills. This leads to an otherwise unreachable Treasure Trove in the Fonsa Myma Waters, containing Gold, a Common Core Crystal, and Priestess's Auspices. Jankie can be found here during Boys and Bullies.

Lucky Dawn Breads are Staple Food Pouch items in . They can be purchased at Tilly Bakery in Torigoth in the Gormott Province, but only at dawn (05:00 - 06:59). One of them must be purchased for Our Daily Bread.

Lovemerry Cakes are Desserts items in . They can be made at Gorg's Just Desserts shop in Fonsa Myma using his "Patissier" field skill. The shop is unlocked upon completion of the Blade Quest Follow Your Passion.
The Linka Hive (Japanese: , Rinka Hachinosu) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Cliffs of Morytha, on a ledge near the entrance to Idora Cave.
Lybarian Chowders are Veggie Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Corcaja Greengrocers in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.
Luna Lizard Wreath are Art Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Talmye Antiques in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

The Lutino Deeds are Deeds key items in . They can be purchased from Cafe Lutino at Goetius Port in the Indoline Praetorium, and later at Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago after Chapter 8. The Lutino Deeds may only be available once the party has purchased one of each item from Maxello after he moves to Fonsett. If the items have been beforehand purchased from him, they will not count and must be purchased again.
Lucida is an NPC in . Lucida is a Leftherian who can be found in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago. Lucida runs a shop called Speck Butchers specialized in Meats.

Lun Scorpoxes (Japanese: , Ruin Sukopio) are enemies in . They are members of the Scorpox family, and can be found at level 44 - 47 at the Wonder Spring Plaza Ruins, the Middle Worm-Ridden Cave or the Penitents' Spring on the Mid Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Dahlia's level 4 "Spotlight", and Perun's level 4 "Silent Spear". Two of them must be defeated to unlock Elma 's level 4 "Focus".

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Love Threads (Japanese: , Jōnetsu no Ito) are accessories in and . They extend the range of the Affinity Bond between Driver and Blade by up to 1.7 meters, making the bond easier to maintain while moving or when the wearer is inflicted with Stench. They are the upgraded version of the Red Thread accessory. The Passion Thread accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect.

Limitless Roses are Flower collectibles in . They can be found in the World Tree, in particular from the Collection Point in the corner of the room next to the Lv. 2, Mizar: Central Deck and the collection point near the airflow at the 7th Perimeter Skyport. In the , Limitless Roses can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo. They can be given to Pekka to grow the Ominous Ardun into the Relentless Arduran. Each one gives 2 points of progress.

Linka Honeys are Flower collectibles in . They can be found at the Cliffs of Morytha, specifically at the Collection Point located at the Runo Cave-in Skip Travel Point. One is needed during the second route of Souvenirs from Morytha.

Love Lemons are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal, in particular from the southeast Collection Point near the Memorial Ruins. In the , Love Lemons can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Love Raspberries are Tree collectibles in . They can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain, in particular from the Collection Point found by jumping down from the cliff when coming from the Old Plumbing Entrance. One is required to make Gorg's Trial Lovemerry Cake during the Blade Quest Follow Your Passion.

Luckroaches are Insect collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal, specifically at the Collection Points in the Sacred Ice Caverns. These bugs are said to bring happiness and cause good things to happen.

Lily's Aux Cores is a shop in . It can be found in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. It is specialized in Aux Cores. Like all Aux Core shops, it does not sell Aux Cores, but is used to refine Aux Cores.
Lleman Blacksmiths is a shop in . It is run by Allain and can be found in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya. It is specialized in Core Chips.
Lost Glyph Plates are Treasure items in . They can be obtained by Salvaging at any Gormott Salvage Point.
Lucky Telefactors are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at Jubilee Gate on the Cliffs of Morytha. One is needed during Souvenirs from Morytha.

Lodranite Chips are Core Chips in and . They can be purchased at the Casheefs Blacksmiths shop in the Kingdom of Tantal, dropped by a wide variety of enemies primarily in Tantal, and in are given as a reward for Planning for the Future and dropped by three enemies in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna. Lodranite Chips share their appearance with Brachinite Chips, Ureilite Chips, and Winonaite Chips. __TOC__

Linka Skeets (Japanese: , Rinka Sukīto) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Skeeter family, and can be found at level 47-49 at the Runo Cave-in on the Cliffs of Morytha. They can be summoned at level 45-47 by Acar Nests at the Linka Hive by its art "Emergence". Five must be defeated to unlock Pandoria's level 2 "Electric Mastery" and Kora's level 3 "Electric Mastery" Field Skills.

Llonya is an NPC in . Llonya is a Common Blade driven by Therida, who can initially be found at the Clear Sky Beak in the Gormott Province. Llonya gives the quest The Driver in Ice, upon completion of which she can be found at Elmos Square in the Kingdom of Tantal with Therida.
Lucarion is an NPC in . Lucarion is a Tantalese who can be found at the Theosoir Rear Gate in the Kingdom of Tantal. Lucarion gives the quest The Lost Turtle.
Lutie is an NPC in . Lutie is an Ardainian who can be found at the Central Exchange in the Argentum Trade Guild during Fool's Gold.

Lynnaeon is an NPC in . He is a Leftherian who can be found in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago in the garden near Corinne's House. He offers the Merc Mission Field Pests. Lynnaeon is an agriculturist, working hard on the small crops in Fonsett. He tells the player that he remembers Rex as a "young tyke" well and that even then, Rex was a good helper in the fields.
Llin is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti shopkeeper who can be found at the Torigoth Market in the Gormott Province. Llin runs the Masnach Exchange shop specialized in exchanging.

The Lucky Core Crystal is a special Core Crystal in . It allows the chosen Driver to awaken the Blade Kasandra. It can be obtained from the Gluttonous Marrin after Salvaging at Chansagh Wastes in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Lope is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who can be found in the Galad Residential Zone of Torigoth in the Gormott Province.

Limits of Awareness (Japanese: , Shikiiki) is a Blade Quest in . It is available after completing the series of tasks for Adenine's Books, and can be received by going to the Goldmouth Warehouse with Adenine in the party. Upon completion of this quest, Adenine receives the level 5 "Extra-Ancient Wisdom" Field Skill, and she appears in the Data Processing Room when she is not in the party. She claims it will take over a thousand years to decipher all the information that has been found.
Limdo Flamii Eggs are Enemy Part collectibles in . They can be dropped by Limdo Flamiis in the Kingdom of Uraya. Five are required for the Whelzaman Cookie recipe during Theory and Praxis.

The Loyal Celdros (Japanese: , Chūjitsu no Kerubadarosu) is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is Saffran's dog-like creature of the Ardainian Soldier group, and can be found at level 59 on the Titan Battleship's Bridge in the Gormott Province, alongside Veteran Saffran during the quest Marvelous Mercenaries.

Lost Kingdom (Japanese: , Ō no Ikō, Royal Authority) is a Blade Quest in . It can be received from Dagas at Midorl Bridge in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the evening (16:00 – 18:59). After the quest is completed, Dagas's Affinity Chart is reset, with the field skill "Cavalier Attitude" replaced by "Nopon Wisdom", "Mineralogy" and "Ancient Wisdom".

The Lindwurm Cougar (Japanese: , Rintovurumu Kūgā) is a quest-exclusive boss in . It is a Lindwurm Titan, fought at level 53 at the Bulge Harbor in the Old Factory of the Empire of Mor Ardain during the quest Eternal Spirit.

The Lindwurm Drake (Japanese: , Rintovurumu Dorēku) is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . He is a member of Lindwurm who is fought at level 51 at Bulge Harbor in the Old Factory of the Empire of Mor Ardain during Eternal Spirit.

Lindwurm Falcons (Japanese: , Rintovurumu Faruku) are three quest-exclusive bosses in . They are members of Lindwurm that are fought at level 48 at Bulge Harbor in the Old Factory of the Empire of Mor Ardain during Eternal Spirit.

Lindwurm Hinds (Japanese: , Rintovurumu Haindo) are two quest-exclusive bosses in . They are fighter plane-like weaponized Titans used by Lindwurm that are fought at level 52 at Bulge Harbor in the Old Factory of the Empire of Mor Ardain during the quest Eternal Spirit.

The Littlepon Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission New Sounds. It enables the purchase of Mumuni the Littlepon from the Reedirait Bookstore shop at Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild.

The Love and War Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Secret Route. It enables the purchase of Addam's Love and War from the Aldomar Books shop at Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Luxury Stage (Japanese: , Gōkana Sutēji) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula's Vocals, Looks and Soul reach Level 7. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Water Mastery", "Wind Mastery" and "Icecraft" Field Skills. It increases Ursula's fanbase by a significant amount. This mission will become unobtainable if not unlocked before the end of the quest.

Looks Lesson 1 (Japanese: , Rukkusu Ressun 1) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul. The time required to complete this mission is 10 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 2 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Keen Eye" and "Wind Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards Looks Stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's Looks Level. It also slightly increases Ursula's fanbase the first time it is cleared.

Looks Lesson 2 (Japanese: , Rukkusu Ressun 2) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula's Looks reach Level 2. The time required to complete this mission is 10 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 2 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Keen Eye" and "Electric Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards Looks Stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's Looks Level. It also slightly increases Ursula's fanbase the first time it is cleared.

Looks Lesson 3 (Japanese: , Rukkusu Ressun 3) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula's Looks reach Level 4. The time required to complete this mission is 10 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 2 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Keen Eye" and "Earth Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards Looks Stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's Looks Level. It also slightly increases Ursula's fanbase the first time it is cleared.

Looks Lesson 4 (Japanese: , Rukkusu Ressun 4) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula's Looks reach Level 6. The time required to complete this mission is 10 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 2 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Keen Eye" and "Water Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards Looks Stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's Looks Level. It also slightly increases Ursula's fanbase the first time it is cleared. This mission will become unobtainable if not unlocked before the end of the quest.

Looks Lesson 5 (Japanese: , Rukkusu Ressun 5) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula's Looks reach Level 8. The time required to complete this mission is 10 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 2 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Keen Eye", "Fire Mastery" and "Dark Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards Looks Stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's Looks Level. It also slightly increases Ursula's fanbase the first time it is cleared. This mission will become unobtainable if not unlocked before the end of the quest.
This is a list of pre-release and unused content for the game and .

Little Rex is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located in Rex's Secret Base in the Leftherian Archipelago. It can be accessed from the lower area ramp on the western edge of the Fonsett Residential Area by burning the vines with the required level 5 "Fire Mastery" and level 3 "Wind Mastery" Field Skills. It features a conversation between Rex, Pyra, Nia and Gramps.

The Lost People's Tablet is a Key Item in . It must be purchased for 1,000 G at Biblio Paulio in Theosoir, Tantal during the Blade Quest Lost Kingdom. Buying it triggers the quest Dagas's Past: Tantal.
Lion Claw is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using Rockrending Gauntlets.
Lustrous Heal is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using Brilliant Twinblades. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0).

Lunar Salutation (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Cobra Bardiche. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Mòrag's Twin Dragons.
Little Jacko is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. He runs a shop called Malbren Salvaging.

Lomlom is an NPC in . He is a Nopon worker who can be found on piping outside the Goldmouth Wheelhouse in the Argentum Trade Guild. He offers the Merc Mission Crane Protection. Lomlom works with metal and repairs inside Goldmouth, and comments on you taking "great pain" to reach him. He hints at having a story to tell the party, but always puts off actually telling it by saying he "doesn't have enough information yet" and asks the party to come back later. He then gives tips on the Idea Stat mechanics of the game.

M.I.A. Nopon is a DLC Quest in . It is one of five quests released as downloadable content, the New Quests Pack 1 of the Expansion Pass. After starting chapter 3 and collecting the unlock item from the "Expansion Pass" menu, the quest can be received from Konakona by Drillbore Bridge in the Kingdom of Uraya. After completion of this quest, Budada can be found in Argentum's Goldmouth Res. Dist. where he will craft Premium Cylinders.

Luck Mod is a Role CPU in . It grants Poppi a Healer role with average defenses and low aggro generation. It offers a modifier that increases Tora's Luck stat by a percentage. It specializes in maximizing reaction infliction chance, and can be used to customize Poppi α and Poppi QTπ. Poppi QT is not compatible with this part. __TOC__

Luck Boost (Japanese: , Un Purasu) is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It increases Tora's Luck stat by up to 25. This effect applies even when the Poppi form equipped with this part isn't active on the field. It is equivalent in effect to the Bunnit Choker and Gold Gear Choker accessories. It can be used to customize Poppi α and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. Poppi QT is not compatible with this part. __TOC__
Lucanos is an NPC in . Lucanos is a Tantalese man who can be found sitting in Anastatia's in the Kingdom of Tantal at night. Lucanos offers the Merc Mission Warming Stralu.
Lone Wolf is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at Cape Singbreeze in the Gormott Province. It features a conversation between Sever, his Driver, and Cressidus.
Lunatheo is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found at the Admar Storage Zone in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He is spoken to during the quest Failure and Success.
Looks Stamps are Key Items in . They can be obtained as rewards for completing the Merc Missions Looks Lessons 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 during the quest Bearing Her Soul.
Lulili is an NPC in . She can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal, by walk along the left side of the Great Pillar Passage. Lulili is one of the Twelve Brothersisterpon.

Lingering Resentment (Japanese: , Ikon, Grudges) is a Blade Quest in . After installing the Patch (Ver.1.4.0) and having cleared the game's main story, this quest is unlocked and can be received from T-elos at the Olethro Ruins in the Kingdom of Uraya. Should this quest be completed with KOS-MOS awakened, a short scene will play at the end of the quest between the two Blades.

Lucidran Guldos (Japanese: , Rushidora Gurudu) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Guldo family fought at level 56 during the first wave of the Challenge Battle Dread Contagion. This enemy drops no items.

Livid Upas (Japanese: , Angurī Ūpā) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Upa family, and are fought at level 90 during the Challenge Battle Dino Drama. These enemies drop no items.
Lucent Glance (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using the Monado. This art recycles Nia's Buckler Slam.

Loyal Bellflower Nia (Japanese: ) is a DLC Aux Core in . It increases the damage bonus effect of Fusion Combos by 36%. It also changes Nia's Blade form appearance when she equips the core, granting her a darker color scheme. It can be purchased at the DLC shop Noponstone Exchange after Chapter 7 for 20 Flawless Noponstones in the Land of Challenge obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. Its effect is functionally identical to the Fusion Combo Up VI Aux Core. The Disguised Pyra DLC Aux Core has a slightly weaker version of this equipment's effect.
Lucky Colorful Salads are Veggies in . They can be created by Jin at Campsites.

The Loftin Nature Preserve (Japanese: , Rotta Shinrin Hogoku) is a landmark in . It is located in the southwestern area of the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna, accessible from Lake Wynn. A ruined staircase from here leads down to Feltley Village, around the Great Crater. There are two Treasure Troves and several Collection Points here. The Peach Slate Piece can be found here.
M-BODY-RNG is Skell Wear torso armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is standard equipment for the Lailah Queen.
M-HEAD-RNG is Skell Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is standard equipment for the Lailah Queen.
M-LARM-RNG is Skell Wear left arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is standard equipment for the Lailah Queen.
M-RARM-RNG is Skell Wear right arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is standard equipment for the Lailah Queen.
M-LEGS-RNG is Skell Wear leg armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is standard equipment for the Lailah Queen.
Lyanne Meadow (Japanese: , Riāne Sōgen) is a location in . It is located in the central area of Gormott, north of the Lakeshore Campsite and adjacent to the Ordia Great Plains.

Lunar Amaruq (Japanese: , Gekkō no Rupusu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Volff family and can be found at night at level 34 in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna, just outside Hyber Village.

The Lowe Blant (Japanese: , Furowa Barando) is a Quest Exclusive Enemy in . It is a member of the Blant family and can be found at level 42 on Turqos Plateau in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna. It must be defeated during Proof of Love, and upon defeat the party obtains the Rainbow Blossom. As with all Quest-exclusive Enemies in , the Lowe Blant drops no items, only gold.
Love-Hate Sausages are Meat items in . They can be created by Mythra at Campsites.
Literally Killer Tarts are Dessert items in . They can be created by Mythra at Campsites.

Love Doughnuts are Dessert items in . They are obtainable by trading 100,000 Bonus EXP for them with the Nopon Traveling Bard located at the Auresco, Rear Gate in Auresco during New Game Plus. The Love Doughnut is the only Pouch item in that cannot be crafted at Campsites.
